title: Heirloom: Carrying a Phone's Personalization Across Base-Model Generations
note: arXiv:2611.00650. Primary source for the article's design description and headline figures (1.7pp accuracy gap, 38 min / 20% battery for the 4B transfer, 8.9% / 26.3% weight-remapping comparison, 3.8KB stored distribution).

title: LoRASuite: Efficient LoRA Adaptation Across Large Language Model Upgrades
note: arXiv:2505.13515. Cited in Section 4 as the weight-remapping comparison baseline. The Heirloom authors state the published code does not support the model pair they tested, so they reimplemented LoRASuite's formulas themselves and applied them to the Phi-3.5-mini -> Phi-4-mini upgrade.
